summary_brief: AI Agent 生态系统迎来多智能体架构元年：OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini CLI、LangChain DeepAgents 三大平台同步引入子智能体系统和分布式编排能力。Claude 4.6 正式支持 1M token 超长上下文，标志着大模型进入百万级上下文时代。安全性成为焦点，CrewAI 修复关键沙箱逃逸漏洞，Dify 加强企业级安全合规。

engineering_signals.title: 多智能体架构成为主流：子智能体系统集体涌现
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini CLI、LangChain DeepAgents 三大平台在同一周期内同步推出子智能体架构，标志着 AI Agent 从单任务执行向协作式多智能体系统演进，将深刻影响 AI 应用的架构设计模式。

engineering_signals.title: Claude 4.6 发布 1M token 上下文窗口，大模型进入百万级时代
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 正式支持 1M token 上下文窗口，这是 AI 模型能力的重大突破，将极大提升长文档处理、代码库分析和复杂任务能力，推动 AI 应用场景的边界扩展。

engineering_signals.title: AI 推理过程可视化成为平台级标配功能
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 在 Python、Go、Java、TypeScript 全平台 SDK 同步 GA 发布 thinking-display-setting，GPT-5.4 也引入 thinking 标签，表明 AI 推理过程透明化已成为行业共识，开发者可以更好地理解和调试 AI 决策。

engineering_signals.title: AI 工具安全性升级：沙箱逃逸修复与企业级合规
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 修复关键沙箱逃逸漏洞，Dify 完善企业级 API 错误处理并修复 SQL 注入，gptme 用显式检查替代断言，表明 AI 工具正在从实验性项目向生产级安全标准演进。

engineering_signals.title: IDE 深度集成 AI Agent，编辑器演变为 AI 协作环境
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 编辑器深度集成 AI 智能体面板和 Worktree，Cline 全面修复 Windows 平台兼容性，表明 IDE 正在从代码编辑器演变为 AI 协作开发环境，跨平台支持成为基础要求。

engineering_signals.title: Agent SDK 增强：技能定义、记忆管理与精细 Token 追踪
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Agent SDK 新增 skills、memory、mcpServers 字段定义能力，支持每轮对话的精细 token 追踪，为多 Agent 架构提供更强大的可编程性和成本分析能力。

engineering_signals.title: 客户端-服务器架构解耦成为 Agent 工具新范式
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: DeepAgents 实现 CLI 与远程 LangGraph 服务器的解耦，OpenDevin 引入可配置沙箱复用策略，OpenCode 进行 Effect 模式服务重构，表明 Agent 工具正在向模块化、可扩展的架构演进。

release_signals.title: Anthropic 推出思考过程显示控制
release_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 全平台 SDK 正式发布(GA) thinking-display-setting 功能，允许开发者控制模型思考过程的可见性，这对需要透明推理过程的应用场景至关重要。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 增强多智能体与实时能力
release_signals.why_it_matters: 引入智能审批守护子代理、实时 WebSocket 转录模式、v2 交接支持以及 Python SDK，显著提升了多智能体协作能力和实时交互体验。

release_signals.title: LlamaIndex 全面弃用 Python 3.9
release_signals.why_it_matters: 生态系统级的技术债务清理，强制用户升级到 Python 3.10+，为后续利用新语言特性铺平道路。

release_signals.title: Fabric 集成 Codex OAuth 认证
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Codex AI 供应商插件，支持 OpenAI OAuth PKCE 流程和浏览器登录，简化了用户认证体验。

release_signals.title: DeepAgents 实现客户端-服务器架构
release_signals.why_it_matters: CLI 可通过 langgraph dev 连接远程代理后端，实现 UI 与运行时解耦，支持服务端执行工作流。

release_signals.title: Cline 新增 CoreWeave 推理提供商
release_signals.why_it_matters: 集成 W&B Inference by CoreWeave 作为新 API 提供商，提供 17 个模型选择，扩展了模型生态。

## New Features
- Supported models can now request full-resolution image inspection through both `view_image` and `codex.emitImage(..., detail: "original")`, which helps with precision visual tasks. (#14175)
- `js_repl` now exposes `codex.cwd` and `codex.homeDir`, and saved `codex.tool(...)` / `codex.emitImage(...)` references keep working across cells. (#14385, #14503)
- Realtime websocket sessions gained a dedicated transcription mode, plus v2 handoff support through the `codex` tool, with a unified `[realtime]` session config. (#14554, #14556, #14606)
- The v2 app-server now exposes filesystem RPCs for file reads, writes, copies, directory operations, and path watching, and there is a new Python SDK for integrating with that API. (#14245, #14435)
- Smart Approvals can now route review requests through a guardian subagent in core, app-server, and TUI, reducing repeated setup work on follow-up approvals. (#13860, #14668)
- App integrations now use the Responses API tool-search flow, can suggest missing tools, and fall back cleanly when the active model does not support search-based lookup. (#14274, #14287, #14732)

## Bug Fixes
- Spawned subagents now inherit sandbox and network rules more reliably, including project-profile layering, persisted host approvals, and symlinked writable roots. (#14619, #14650, #14674, #14807)
- `js_repl` no longer hangs when dynamic tool responses contain literal U+2028 or U+2029 characters. (#14421)
- The TUI no longer stalls on exit after creating subagents, and interrupting a turn no longer tears down background terminals by default. (#14816, #14602)
- `codex exec --profile` once again preserves profile-scoped settings when starting or resuming a thread. (#14524)
- MCP and elicitation flows are more robust, with safer tool-name normalization and preserved `tool_params` in approval prompts. (#14491, #14605, #14769)
- The local network proxy now serves CONNECT traffic as explicit HTTP/1, improving compatibility with HTTP proxy clients. (#14395)

## Chores
- The subagent wait tool is now consistently named `wait_agent`, aligning it with `spawn_agent` and `send_input`. (#14631)

### Highlights

* **Client-server architecture:** The CLI can now connect to a remote agent backend via `langgraph dev`, decoupling the UI from the runtime and unlocking server-side execution workflows.
* **Expanded model ecosystem:** Added LiteLLM and Baseten as built-in providers. The `/model` selector now shows live model status, supports an `enabled` flag to hide providers, and auto-discovers models for `class_path` (arbitrary) providers.

source_issues.evidence: User cannot paste from Excel Online or web editors - clipboard shows 'Try to paste with unsupported clipboard format: HTML Format'. Pasting completely fails without any feedback.

source_issues.title: Intermittent issues with copying text to clipboard (Linux, KDE Plasma Wayland session)
source_issues.evidence: Text doesn't get copied to clipboard most of the time on Linux Wayland - user cannot copy/paste which is a core editor workflow. Copied text doesn't show in KDE clipboard manager.

signals.topic: Helix mode commands broken (paste, mode switching)
signals.summary: Users who use Helix mode cannot paste from system clipboard and mode switching is broken, blocking basic editing workflows for this user segment.
signals.review_reason: Users who use Helix mode cannot paste from system clipboard and mode switching is broken, blocking basic editing workflows for this user segment.

source_issues.title: HelixPaste appears broken (for system clipboard)
source_issues.evidence: vim: helix paste command does nothing when pasting from system clipboard, while vim: paste works fine. Core editing operation fails for Helix users.

source_issues.title: Switching between vim mode and helix mode doesn't work properly
source_issues.evidence: Toggle helix mode requires 3 actions instead of 1 to actually switch modes - first toggle does nothing, second resets to normal mode, third finally switches.

signals.topic: Pinned tabs lost when reconnecting to remote projects
signals.summary: Pinned tabs are core workflow for organizing work. Users working with remote projects lose all pinned tabs on restart, forcing them to re-pin files repeatedly. Marked as 'common' frequency with reproducible steps.
signals.review_reason: Pinned tabs are core workflow for organizing work. Users working with remote projects lose all pinned tabs on restart, forcing them to re-pin files repeatedly. Marked as 'common' frequency with reproducible steps.

source_issues.title: Pinned tabs are frequently lost when using remote projects
source_issues.evidence: Log shows 'Pinned tab count (4) exceeds actual tab count (1). This should not happen.' - users lose all pinned tabs after restarting Zed with remote projects, breaking workflow restoration.

signals.topic: Windows extensions/themes fail to install
signals.summary: Complete failure of extension system on Windows. Users cannot install language support, themes, or any extensions - marked as 'common' frequency, blocking Windows users from customizing Zed.

source_issues.title: Themes and Extensions do not get installed in the Windows version
source_issues.evidence: Install button shows progress but extension never appears - install button re-enables. Windows users cannot install any extensions or themes at all.
